title: ホープフルSの後に・火花散る

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's name travels far as her exploits fill the audience of the Hopeful Stakes with wonder after she has a successful run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is the first race in the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's fighting spirit burns brightly as we head down the path of the Satsuki Sho!
